name: CALLS_UNREACHED
description: The subject, the one Unknown caller (actor:unknown-caller), calls entry points of the object unit that nothing in the analysed set reaches and no person is shown to use (ADR 0074, amendment for #365; #766): HTTP and WebSocket endpoints, listeners on queues or topics nothing publishes to, or a gateway's routes when nothing calls the gateway. A kind of INTERACTS_WITH, a type of its own so derivation does not write what the linker writes. Who really calls them is unknown.

facts.description: The facts of the entry points nothing reaches: endpoint, websocket-endpoint, message-listener or routed-endpoint facts.
